prompt: One giant castle that is the whole settlement, the shops and homes inside its walls.

card.name: Castle Town

site.text: One giant castle that is the whole settlement, with shops and homes inside its walls

purpose.text: A walled castle that serves as a whole living settlement, with homes and shops inside

card.interpretation: The whole settlement is a single giant castle: a walled keep-and-courtyard town on ordinary level ground, sized XL to fit within your 64-block claim. Shops and homes stand inside the walls. I took the look as classic medieval stone since you gave no style, and the purpose as a home base that also lives like a small town.
assumptions: Style is medieval stone, as none was given
Purpose is home base with shops and homes
Size is XL because the castle is giant
Density is high, as everything is packed inside the walls
Terrain is flat ground; no sculpting asked for
Location is searched, as no spot was named

program.notes: Tallest building, the castle's heart with a great hall, throne room and battlements.
Barbican with portcullis and murder holes; the only way in through the curtain wall.
Round towers at each corner of the curtain wall, linked by a wall walk.
Timber and stone homes packed along inner lanes against the walls.
Small homes for servants and craftsmen near the walls.
Stalls and shopfronts around the courtyard square: general goods, baker, tailor.
Gathering place off the courtyard with rooms upstairs.
Forge for weapons and armour, set by the barracks.
Bunks and training yard for the castle guard.
Small stone chapel with stained glass in a quiet corner.
Horses, hay and stores kept near the gate.
